title: Umami Rich Polish Mushroom Gratin
description: A savory Polish dish featuring mushrooms, pomegranate, and a mother sauce base, perfect for a hangover cure, made in individual mini cocottes. This satvik friendly recipe is a great option for a comforting meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until softened.
Add the mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Stir in the bechamel sauce, salt, and black pepper, and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for a few minutes until it thickens.
Stir in the chopped fresh thyme and pomegranate seeds.
Transfer the mixture to individual mini cocottes or ramekins.
Top each cocotte with shredded gruyere cheese.
Place the cocottes on a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the cocottes from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
